items.question: What is included in UI/UX Design?
items.answer: Our UI/UX Design service includes user research, wireframes, prototypes, design systems, and high-fidelity interfaces ready for development teams to use.

items.question: How long does a website project usually take?
items.answer: The timeline depends on project complexity. Landing pages typically take 2–4 weeks, while web apps or larger applications usually take longer depending on the required features.

items.question: Do you offer maintenance after the website is launched?
items.answer: Yes, we provide Maintenance and Support for feature updates, bug fixing, security improvements, and performance optimization after launch.

items.question: Can you handle App Development and UI/UX at the same time?
items.answer: Yes. We can manage everything from research and design to development, deployment, and ongoing support to ensure the final result stays consistent.

items.question: How does collaboration and communication work with the team?
items.answer: The process usually starts with a brief, after which the team prepares a roadmap, revisions, and regular progress updates so clients stay connected from the beginning.

steps.title: Brief
steps.text: A 30-minute discussion to understand the product, target users, and business goals.

steps.title: Design
steps.text: Wireframes, high-fidelity UI, and clickable prototypes ready for feedback.

steps.title: Build
steps.text: Clean code using modern stacks, with weekly progress updates.

steps.title: Launch
steps.text: Deployment, store publication, and 30 days of post-launch support.
